functions.name: BugReportsTab

callGraph.callee:
[...resolverMap.entries()].map(([userId, v]): ResolverStat => ({
      userId,
      userName:     v.userName,
      avgSolution:  v.sol / v.count,
      avgAttention: v.att / v.count,
      avgOverall:   (v.sol + v.att) / (v.count * 2),
      count:        v.count,
    })).sort
